drivingQuestion: When does the owner add one-fifth to the amount by which an outsider raised the bid?
outcomeNote: A single qualifying ruling on the mishna, unchallenged within this unit.

segments.he: שֶׁאֵין מוֹסִיפִין חוֹמֶשׁ עַל עִלּוּיוֹ כּוּ׳. אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא שֶׁלֹּא נִישּׁוֹם הֶקְדֵּשׁ בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה, אֲבָל נִישּׁוֹם הֶקְדֵּשׁ בִּשְׁלֹשָׁה — מוֹסִיפִין.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that even when the owner must give the amount offered by the second person for the field, he adds one-fifth only to the amount that he himself bid, «as he does not add one-fifth to the addition» of the other person. «Rav Ḥisda says:» The mishna «taught» that the owner does not add one-fifth to the addition of the other person «only when» the «consecrated» property «was not appraised by three» people. «But» if the «consecrated» property «was appraised by three» people, and the field was found to be worth the amount offered by the other person, the owner «does add» one-fifth to the addition of the other person.

moves.cueHe: שאין מוסיפין חומש על עילויו כו׳
moves.summary: re-quotes the mishna's clause of arakhin.27b.2 as the lemma
moves.about: quotes the mishna's rule that the owner adds no fifth to the outsider's raise

moves.cueHe: אמר רב חסדא: לא שנו אלא שלא נישום הקדש בשלשה
moves.summary: limits the mishna's rule to a field not appraised by three men
moves.about: the rule that no fifth is added to the outsider's raise holds only where the consecrated field was not appraised by three men

edges.cueHe: שאין מוסיפין חומש על עילויו כו׳
edges.about: quotes the mishna's rule that the owner adds no fifth to the outsider's raise

edges.cueHe: לא שנו אלא שלא נישום הקדש בשלשה, אבל נישום הקדש בשלשה — מוסיפין
edges.about: the rule that no fifth is added to the outsider's raise holds only where the consecrated field was not appraised by three men
